projects.name: Singing practice
observations: Jordan picked 'Fast Car' to perform because the range works and it's a widely known song
Practiced the song five times in the living room with guitar
First two run-throughs had voice cracking and timing issues on the bridge
By the third run-through found a groove
By the fifth run-through was actually singing rather than performing the motions
